Dr. Emma Frost: I was in the lab from midnight until 3:00 AM, running long climate simulations. It’s on the opposite side of the station from the sleeping quarters, so I wasn’t in a position to see everything happening there.

At about 1:15, I saw Mark walking toward Viktor’s quarters. I can’t say what he did after that. Around 1:30, I heard raised voices. I couldn’t make out the words, and at first I thought it was the wind or the station creaking. I didn’t see who was speaking.

At about 2:30, I checked on the simulation and noticed the radio room door was open. That was unusual. I stayed in the lab until 3:00. I’m sorry—I wish I’d checked sooner, but I didn’t know anything was wrong.
